releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: InniClassic 20261104
releases.source_notes:
### InniClassic Release

Automated build with full support for **Innioasis Y1** (Type A & Type B) and **Innioasis Y2**.

#### 📦 Release Assets

| File | Target Device | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`InniClassic-20261104.apk`** | All Devices (Y1 / Y2) | Standalone launcher APK (sideload or install) |
| **`update.json`** | All Devices | OTA update metadata for in-app updater |
| **`rom_y2.zip`** | **Innioasis Y2** (MT6582) | Complete flashable ROM with dual-storage, watchdog & clickwheel keylayout |
| **`rom_y1_type_a.zip`** (`rom.zip`) | **Innioasis Y1** (Type A) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware **2.0.0 or higher** |
| **`rom_y1_type_b.zip`** (`rom_type_b.zip`) | **Innioasis Y1** (Type B) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware **below 2.0.0** |
| **`SHA256SUMS.txt`** | All Files | SHA-256 integrity checksums |

#### ⚡ Flashing Instructions (SP Flash Tool)
1. Extract the corresponding zip file for your device.
2. Launch `flash_tool.exe` (or Linux `flash_tool`).
3. Load the scatter file (`MT6582_Android_scatter.txt` for Y2, `MT6572_Android_scatter.txt` for Y1).
4. Select **Firmware Upgrade** or **Download Only**.
5. Power off the device completely, click **Download**, and connect the USB cable.

---

* feat(ui): use the iPod Classic layout in the Classic themes, with an iPod status bar and battery warnings by @ferrolho in https://github.com/JonaszPotoniec/inniclassic-y2/pull/23
* feat(theme): change the theme without a restart, and add an Auto theme by @ferrolho in https://github.com/JonaszPotoniec/inniclassic-y2/pull/26

releases.source_notes:
The Biggest Release!

- The entire application codebase has been rewritten from Java to 100% Kotlin, decomposing the monolithic main activity into dedicated domain managers, screen controllers, and an input router, backed by 16 regression test suites running in CI.
- Audiobooks is now a dedicated top-level section on the main menu, with hierarchical Jellyfin sync (Author -> Book -> Chapter), cover art downloads, continuous bookmark persistence across reboots, full chapter playlist resume, and a unified split-screen layout.
- The Videos section now provides a hierarchical browser for Movies, TV Series (with seasons and episodes), and raw directories, split-screen poster previews, Jellyfin video and thumbnail sync, and an automatic directory migration for existing files.
- Music Quiz transitions to an endless survival mode with six questions per round, speed scaling down to five seconds, a between-round pause screen with a heart shop, a persistent top 10 leaderboard, and tiered year question distractors.
- A new Recently Played Albums menu item beneath Cover Flow tracks up to 50 recently played albums with cover art, track counts, track-number-ordered browsing, and an option to clear playback history.
- Device shutdown now saves the active queue and playback position, automatically restoring the player in a paused state at the exact track and timestamp after rebooting.
- Playback cleanly pauses and rewinds to the first track when finishing an album with repeat turned off, while the library scanner now skips files smaller than 1KB and logs corrupt audio files.
- Back navigation now preserves selected row focus and scroll position across the main menu, settings, playlists, and browser lists instead of resetting to the top item.
- Split-screen pages in Music, Videos, and Audiobooks now share a unified 242dp status bar width matching the left navigation pane, while video browsing fixes eliminate poster clipping, top gaps, and double padding.
- Now Playing album art now reliably updates on the main menu and music split panes during playback.
- The theme catalog has been streamlined to Classic Light and Classic Dark, automatically cleaning up leftover assets from legacy themes during startup.
- Physical buttons and wheel haptic feedback are now completely muted while the screen is off when Screen-Off Control is disabled, and the idle backlight sleep timer now stays synchronized with system settings.

releases.source_notes:
- Added Jellyfin sync so you can download music and videos directly from your Jellyfin server over Wi-Fi. You can sign in using QuickConnect (with an on-screen pairing code), username and password, or an API token, then sync all libraries or browse and pick specific folders. Sync options let you download album artwork, transcode videos for playback on the player, and remove local files that were deleted on the server, followed by an automatic library rescan when downloads finish.
- Fixed four Bluetooth issues on the Y2:
  - Toggling Bluetooth on now starts the MediaTek Bluetooth daemon (`mtkbt`) automatically (and starts it at boot in the ROM), fixing the bug where Bluetooth refused to turn back on or reconnect to paired headphones after being turned off.
  - Turning Bluetooth off now stays off across reboots instead of turning itself back on at startup.
  - "Delete Device" now verifies that unpairing succeeded before showing a confirmation message and refreshes the paired list cleanly.
  - "Connect Audio" and "Delete Device" options are now visually indented beneath the selected device row.

releases.source_notes:
- The About screen now uses a scrollable two-column iPod Classic layout showing song, video, album, and artist counts, software version, model number, and separate capacity and free space rows for both internal flash and the microSD card.
- A new "Battery Percentage" setting draws the exact percentage and a compact charging bolt inside the battery icon, with contrasting text colors across the filled and empty parts of the indicator.
- Genre browsing now follows the classic iPod hierarchy (`Genre -> Artists / All Songs -> Albums / All Songs -> Songs`), and song lists have a Shuffle banner with a song counter at the top. Returning from Now Playing also highlights the playing track, fast scrolling no longer crashes on lists with header rows, and the wheel no longer gets stuck at list edges.
- FM Radio now remembers your last tuned frequency and saved station presets across restarts, tunes smoothly with the wheel without screen flicker, supports hardware station seek, and routes audio directly to the 3.5mm headphone jack after pausing any playing music.
- Factory OEM demo tracks in `custom_media` (such as *Despacito* and *Panama*) are no longer scanned, and an automatic cleanup migration removes them from existing libraries while stripping them from newly built ROMs.
- Both button presses and touch events now reset the screen backlight sleep timer, and the screen stays awake automatically during library scans, radio scans, podcast downloads, video playback, and USB storage mode.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: InniClassic 20261001
releases.source_notes:
- Volume now uses a 30-step virtual scale with an iPod-style overlay across all screens instead of the stock Android popup. It works across music, video playback, FM radio, and Music Quiz, and includes six extra-quiet digital sub-steps at the bottom of the scale (down to -28 dBFS) for sensitive earphones.
- A full QWERTY on-screen keyboard is now available in Settings alongside the original grid layout. It includes a symbol layer, column memory when moving vertically across the spacebar, lighter 10ms key vibration, and full punctuation (`; : , / \ ( ) [ ] { } < > ' ~ \`` and `|`) for Wi-Fi passwords and search queries.
- Cover Flow and album lists use a 9-slot buffered layout and a 256x256 disk and RAM thumbnail cache (`.y1_thumbs_cache`), eliminating card pop-in and lag when spinning the wheel fast or reversing direction.
- Holding the Center button for 0.8 seconds now locks all buttons and turns the screen off (Hold mode, from upstream 1.4.4). Hold Center again to unlock.
- On Now Playing, wheel seeking previews the target time in 5-second steps until you press Center to jump, and pausing in the Classic theme keeps album art bright while remembering your active bottom bar mode. Starting a video also pauses active music so the Play/Pause button controls the video.
- Custom themes no longer reset to the default theme after unplugging from USB Mass Storage because the selected theme is now saved by name instead of folder scan order. Newly created `.scrobbler.log` files also declare `#TZ/UTC` so scrobble importers read their timestamps as UTC.

releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: InniClassic 20260927
releases.source_notes:
First release with support for the Innioasis Y2 alongside the Innioasis Y1 (Type A and Type B).

- Music, audiobooks, and videos are now indexed across both internal storage (`/storage/sdcard0`) and the removable microSD card (`/storage/sdcard1`).
- A background SD card monitor watches for unexpected microSD disconnects, such as after unplugging from USB, and remounts the card automatically before refreshing your library. This also fixes a crash loop during media indexing and stops the monitor from touching internal storage.
- The Y2 capacitive click wheel (`mtk-tpd-kpd`) is mapped to standard left and right scroll navigation across all menus and lists.
- FM radio now works on the Y2. Opening the radio sets tuner device permissions, stops background stock radio apps that would otherwise lock `/dev/fm`, and keeps Airplane Mode from blocking the tuner.
- Automated builds produce flashable ROM packages for the Y2, Y1 Type A, and Y1 Type B, along with a standalone APK.
